thread:
maria-partners: Quick sync — prepping the infra-kit modules (AWS & GCP) for Marketplace publish. Need final README examples, CI tests, and a runbook for customers. Who can own docs + QA this week? :wave:

alex-cloud: I can take docs. Can we standardize on two reference stacks? For AWS: webapp + redis + s3 + kms. For GCP: webapp + memorystore + gcs + kms. Keep examples minimal and copy-paste friendly.

dan-sdks: I'll add usage snippets to the SDK samples repo. Proposed module inputs: env, region, instance_type, node_count, kms_key_id. Tiny example for README: 
```hcl
module "infra_webapp" {
  source        = "github.com/redwood-inference/infra-kit//modules/webapp"
  env           = "staging"
  region        = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "t4g.large"
  node_count    = 2
}
```
I'll also include a short Go + Python snippet showing how to fetch outputs.

sam-solutions: QA here — plan to wire up GH Actions acceptance flow: terraform fmt/validate, init + plan (no apply), then a smoke deploy to sandbox via terratest. Rough ETA: 48 hours once docs + examples land.

jeff-legal: Quick legal check: marketplace listing needs a short data-flow statement + export-control review. Can someone drop the draft wording in the checklist doc so I can review? Also confirm no customer data is stored outside customer-owned buckets.

maria-partners: Added a living checklist (internal link): https://redwood-internal/docs/marketplace/infra-kit-publish — includes: docs, examples, CI, security review, legal blurb, tagging, and announcement cadence. Action items I put below.

alex-cloud: For release strategy: semver on modules + prerelease RC tags for partner QA (v1.0.0-rc1), then GA after signoff. CI job (release.yml) should: bump version, run full acceptance, publish to Terraform Registry + attach changelog. Example release command in CI: 
```bash
git tag -a v1.0.0-rc1 -m "infra-kit v1.0.0-rc1"
./ci/release.sh --module webapp --version v1.0.0-rc1
```

deploy-bot: :rocket: CI passed: infra-kit/webapp acceptance (release/infrac-kit -> v1.0.0-rc1) — checks: fmt, validate, plan, smoke-deploy.

sam-solutions: Nice — once CI is green I'll kick off the sandbox apply and capture step-by-step runbook entries (credentials, timing, rollback). Expect to upload runbook notes by EOD Fri.

maria-partners: Perfect. Assigning owners: docs @alex-cloud, SDK snippets @dan-sdks, QA @sam-solutions, legal review @jeff-legal. I'll consolidate the checklist and schedule a 15-min sync Thurs AM to confirm announcement timing with PM/marketing. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
